craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of marshalled examples — parity and fencing. Fitness shows higher self; others-sake kept. Rejected: (a) sake→behalf → killed: sake is leaner. Read aloud: AS com-bi-NA-tion SEEN … UN-com-POUND-ed HIGH-er.

lines: As combination seen for others' sake alone —
in eye and the rest, by that fitness: the self-dear, uncompounded higher.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yathā pārārthyamātreṇa saṃghātatve'nvitekṣite cakṣurādau tadaucityādātmeṣṭo'saṃhataḥ paraḥ

reads_against.argmap: How is the higher self shown in eye etc.? → The higher self shows in eye etc. by fitness, as combination seen for another's sake.
c1_essence: Stock examples turned: eye-fitness shows the higher self; smoke-fire proves khadira-wood by mere knowing (vv10-11).
The hetu fenced, others sifting, the whole Lord-made; helpers' strange way opened, pictured, and bounded; fancied spread refused (vv12-18).
